title: Crash after commit, before ack: the redelivery is caught by the seen id
caption: At-least-once delivery plus dedup in the consumer gives an exactly-once effect.

messages.label: txn: insert seen m1 + print label
messages.note: Both rows commit together, or neither does.

messages.label: crash before ack
messages.note: The broker never hears that m1 was handled.

messages.label: redeliver m1
messages.note: After the visibility timeout or rebalance, m1 goes to a worker again.

messages.label: insert seen m1 → duplicate
messages.note: The unique id rejects it, so the transaction rolls back and no second label is printed.

messages.label: ack m1
messages.note: Ack anyway: the message is handled. The window must outlive the longest redelivery delay.
